question: Who among the following is the best Rudra Veena player in Hindustani Classical Music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Asad Ali Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustad Asad Ali Khan**

 
 
• **Asad Ali Khan** was an Indian performer who played the culled string instrument rudra veena.
 
• Khan acted in the style dhrupad and was depicted as the best living rudra veena player in India by The Hindu.</s
